Remarkable Overestimation of Soil N₂O Emission by Using Static Chambers
Changing Emissions and Atmospheric Chemistry: Ongoing Impacts on Air Quality and Climate
zh: 讨论排放控制与能源转型如何改变二次气溶胶、活性氮和持久性污染物的环境过程。
提出连接排放变化、大气化学与环境暴露的研究重点，支撑空气质量和气候的协同评估。
en: We examine how emission controls and the energy transition reshape secondary aerosols, reactive nitrogen, and persistent pollutants.
We identify research priorities connecting changing emissions, atmospheric chemistry, and exposure to inform air-quality and climate assessments.

Understanding summertime H₂O₂ chemistry in the North China Plain through observations and modeling studies
zh: 结合华北农村夏季观测与箱式模型，量化 H₂O₂ 的生成和损失过程。
颗粒物摄取是关键损失途径；纳入该过程可改善模型高估，并帮助理解多污染物减排的化学响应。
en: We combine summer observations and box modeling to quantify H₂O₂ production and loss in rural North China.
Particle uptake is a major sink; including it improves model agreement and clarifies oxidant responses to emission reductions.

Role of Heterogeneous Reactions in the Atmospheric Oxidizing Capacity in Island Environments
zh: 科西嘉岛山顶观测揭示 HONO 白天偏高的日变化，现有参数化仍无法解释大部分日间来源。
光敏非均相反应可能被低估，凸显地表化学对岛屿环境 OH 自由基生成的重要作用。
en: Hilltop observations on Corsica reveal daytime HONO maxima and substantial formation missing from current parameterizations.
Underestimated photosensitized surface reactions may explain the gap, highlighting their importance for OH production in island environments.

Reducing Soil-Emitted Nitrous Acid as a Feasible Strategy for Tackling Ozone Pollution
zh: 田间通量观测与实验表明，施肥显著增强土壤 HONO 排放，并促进区域臭氧生成。
硝化抑制剂显示出降低 HONO、NOₓ 和 N₂O 排放的潜力，为农业源臭氧治理提供新思路。
en: Field flux measurements and experiments show that fertilization enhances soil HONO emissions and regional ozone production.
Nitrification inhibitors show potential to reduce HONO, NOₓ, and N₂O emissions, offering a route to address agricultural contributions to ozone pollution.

title: Rapid hydrolysis of NO₂ at High Ionic Strengths of Deliquesced Aerosol Particles
A large role of missing volatile organic compound reactivity from anthropogenic emissions in ozone pollution regulation
Underestimated benefits of NOₓ control in reducing SNA and O₃ based on missing heterogeneous HONO sources
A study on wildfire impacts on greenhouse gas emissions and regional air quality in South of Orléans, France
zh: 结合地面观测、卫星影像与后向轨迹，刻画法国奥尔良附近小规模野火的温室气体和污染物排放。
烟羽影响延伸至区域尺度，同时揭示不同火灾排放清单对小型火灾估算的明显偏差。
en: We characterize greenhouse gases and air pollutants from a small wildfire near Orléans using field observations, satellite imagery, and trajectories.
The plume affected regional air quality, while comparisons reveal substantial uncertainties in inventories of small-fire emissions.

title: Measurement report: Exchange fluxes of HONO over agricultural fields in the North China Plain
zh: 比较施肥与未施肥农田的 HONO 交换通量，发现施肥后数周排放显著增强。
获得夏玉米生长季排放因子，说明农业 HONO 排放对活性氮收支和区域氧化能力的重要性。
en: We compare HONO exchange over fertilized and unfertilized fields and observe strongly enhanced emissions for weeks after fertilization.
A growing-season emission factor quantifies fertilizer-derived HONO and its implications for reactive nitrogen budgets and regional oxidation.

title: HONO chemistry at a suburban site during the EXPLORE-YRD campaign in 2018: formation mechanisms and impacts on O₃ production
A database of aircraft measurements of carbon monoxide (CO) with high temporal and spatial resolution during 2011-2021
zh: 汇集 2011–2021 年跨欧洲、亚洲和非洲的机载 CO 观测，覆盖超过 200 小时飞行测量。
高时间分辨率数据揭示污染输送与垂直分布，并为大气模型及卫星观测验证提供依据。
en: We compile more than 200 flight hours of high-resolution CO measurements across Europe, Asia, and Africa during 2011–2021.
The dataset resolves pollution transport and vertical structure and supports evaluation of atmospheric models and satellite observations.

Strong impacts of biomass burning, nitrogen fertilization, and fine particles on gas-phase hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
zh: 华北农村观测显示，生物质燃烧、施肥后土壤 HONO 排放和颗粒物过程均可增强气态 H₂O₂。
这些常被模型简化的来源影响区域氧化能力，提示需要更完整地描述农业活动与多相化学。
en: Rural observations identify biomass burning, fertilization-related HONO emissions, and particle chemistry as important contributors to H₂O₂.
These processes warrant better representation in models of regional oxidation and sulfate formation.

title: Substantially Growing Interest in the Chemistry of Nitrous Acid (HONO) in China: Current Achievements, Problems, and Future Directions
zh: 梳理中国 HONO 化学研究的进展，指出来源机制与观测、模型解释中的关键分歧。
建议加强垂直梯度和通量观测、实验室动力学及模型约束，以深化对污染环境 HONO 化学的认识。
en: This viewpoint examines progress in Chinese HONO research and unresolved questions about sources and their interpretation.
It calls for coordinated profile and flux measurements, laboratory kinetics, and improved modeling to constrain HONO chemistry in polluted environments.

title: Atmospheric measurements at Mt. Tai – Part I: HONO formation and its role in the oxidizing capacity of the upper boundary layer
zh: 泰山山脚与山顶同步观测表明，山地输送及沿途表面反应可显著影响上边界层 HONO。
HONO 光解在山顶仍是重要 OH 来源，强调模型需考虑近地面化学与垂直交换的耦合。
en: Simultaneous measurements at the foot and summit of Mt. Tai link upper-boundary-layer HONO to vertical transport and mountain-surface chemistry.
HONO remains an important OH source aloft, highlighting the coupling between ground-level chemistry and vertical exchange.

title: Atmospheric measurements at Mt. Tai – Part II: HONO budget and radical (ROₓ + NO₃) chemistry in the lower boundary layer
zh: 利用泰山脚观测约束箱式模型，识别地表 NO₂ 非均相反应对 HONO 收支的重要贡献。
进一步量化日间 HONO 光解与夜间 NO₃ 化学，揭示低边界层氧化过程及其参数化敏感性。
en: An observation-constrained box model identifies ground-surface NO₂ reactions as major HONO sources at the foot of Mt. Tai.
The study quantifies daytime HONO photolysis and nighttime NO₃ chemistry, revealing key controls on lower-boundary-layer oxidation.

Evidence for Strong HONO Emission from Fertilized Agricultural Fields and its Remarkable Impact on Regional O₃ Pollution in the Summer North China Plain
zh: 农业与非农业站点同步观测显示，施肥后 HONO 与臭氧升高，为农田强 HONO 排放提供证据。
HONO 光解显著增强自由基生成，说明农业施肥可影响夏季区域光化学污染。
en: Concurrent agricultural and nonagricultural observations show enhanced HONO and ozone following fertilization in the North China Plain.
Strong radical production from HONO photolysis links fertilized soils to intensified summertime regional photochemistry.

HONO Budget and Its Role in Nitrate Formation in the Rural North China Plain
zh: 结合华北农村冬季观测与箱式模型，解析 HONO 来源及其对硝酸盐形成的作用。
HONO 光解主导初级 OH 生成，地表反应与 NO＋OH 共同维持日间 HONO 并促进气相硝酸盐生成。
en: We use winter observations and box modeling to resolve HONO sources and their role in nitrate formation in rural North China.
HONO photolysis dominates primary OH production, while surface reactions and NO + OH sustain daytime HONO and gas-phase nitrate formation.

Development and application of a twin open-top chambers method to measure soil HONO emission in the North China Plain
zh: 建立并评估双开顶箱方法，实现农田土壤 HONO 排放的直接测量。
外场应用揭示排放的日变化及施肥促进效应，为约束农业 HONO 源提供观测方法。
en: We develop and evaluate a twin open-top chamber method for direct measurements of soil HONO emissions.
Field applications reveal diurnal variability and fertilization-enhanced emissions, providing an observational approach to constrain agricultural HONO sources.

title: A dual dynamic chamber system based on IBBCEAS for measuring fluxes of nitrous acid in agricultural fields in the North China Plain
Development of stripping coil-ion chromatograph method and intercomparison with CEAS and LOPAP to measure atmospheric HONO
zh: 开发吸收盘管—离子色谱 HONO 测量方法，评估吸收液选择与 SO₂ 干扰。
与 CEAS、LOPAP 等方法的外场比对支持其可靠性，并明确湿化学测量的适用条件。
en: We develop a stripping coil–ion chromatography method for HONO and evaluate collection efficiency and SO₂ interference.
Field comparisons with CEAS and LOPAP support its performance and define conditions for reliable wet-chemical measurements.
